title: Sidescan sonar image of inner shelf off Folly Beach, S.C.
citation: Swift, B.A., Paskevich, V.F., Denny, J.F., Cross, V.A., Schwab, W.C., and Gayes, P.T., 1997, Sidescan sonar image of inner shelf off Folly Beach, S.C.: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-97-298, map scale 1:38,000.
notes:
Sidescan-sonar mosaic report (1995 survey, 10x4 km of shoreface and inner shelf off Folly Beach, Klein 100 kHz). No geologic units, logs, structures or aquifers are described; the report covers data collection and image processing. Only the two references on South Carolina coastal geology were recorded; image-processing and out-of-state references (Chavez 1986, Danforth 1997, Denny 1995, Johnson and Helferty 1990, Paskevich 1992a-c, 1996) skipped.
SUBSURFACE: none. The mosaic (fig. 3, pp.6, 12-13) carries bathymetric contours in meters (contour interval 1m) from the survey fathometer; these are sea-floor depths, not a geologic surface, and their datum is not stated.
